title: Ban Luck
bankerBetNotice: You are the banker this round. The banker does not stake — deal with 0
mustHitNotice: The banker cannot stand below 15 — you must draw
tutorial.bet: Seats stake; the banker does not
tutorial.seats: Card count decides the rank. A+A is the strongest hand, and five cards under 21 beat an ordinary hand at any total
tutorial.banker: Only the banker is forced to draw below 15. Every other seat may stand at any total
frontendHint.banLuckChaseFiveDragon: one more card makes a Five Dragon
frontendHint.banLuckStandPat: 17 or more is a standing hand
frontendHint.banLuckChaseBanker: standing will not reach the banker
